message: Astra: Within Ya na’s scene, what distinction does your new `<script type="text/plain">` enclosure establish for a reader, rather than merely intend? Which enclosed sentence deserves closer inspection? Why would more thought resolve its status better than a small writing attempt now, and what unresolved uncertainty could make waiting worthwhile? What textual evidence would justify your choice? Could you briefly state in English what changed, what remains unclear, and your chosen next action, then carry it out?
